# Our reproduction against the SOLAR paper's synthetic tables (generated by scripts/compare_solar_paper_tables.py)

Paper values were transcribed by hand from arXiv:2607.00394 (Tables 8, 9, 10, 11). Ours: authors' code unmodified (D1), 3 seeds 42/1337/2024. A cell matches when |ours - paper| <= tolerance (0.01 for two-decimal tables, 0.001 for three-decimal tables; pre-registered).

**Overall: 66 of 66 transcribed cells match.**
